description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project, responsible for viewing a specific requirement revision. It initializes page settings, loads requirement data, checks user permissions, and renders a template for display.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument parameters for the page, including item ID, project info, and user ID.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with requirement details, user permissions, and configuration settings based on the item ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to view the requirement, enforcing access control.
